transform.name: Compose
transform.repr:

    <ml.training.retinal_preprocessing.RetinalFieldCrop object at 0x000001BD13A7C210>
    Resize(size=(384, 384), interpolation=bilinear, max_size=None, antialias=True)
    ToTensor()
    Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225])
)

train_transform.name: Compose
train_transform.repr:
Compose(
    Resize(size=(384, 384), interpolation=bilinear, max_size=None, antialias=True)
    RandomHorizontalFlip(p=0.5)
    RandomRotation(degrees=[-8.0, 8.0], interpolation=nearest, expand=False, fill=0)
    RandomAffine(degrees=[0.0, 0.0], translate=(0.03, 0.03), scale=(0.95, 1.05))
    ColorJitter(brightness=(0.88, 1.12), contrast=(0.88, 1.12), saturation=(0.92, 1.08), hue=(-0.02, 0.02))
    ToTensor()
    Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225])
)
